verses.greek: Ὀφείλομεν δὲ ἡμεῖς οἱ δυνατοὶ τὰ ἀσθενήματα τῶν ἀδυνάτων βαστάζειν, καὶ μὴ ἑαυτοῖς ἀρέσκειν.
verses.literal: We ought now we ourselves who are strong the weaknesses of the weak to bear and not ourselves to please
verses.dgt: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of those who are not strong, and not to please ourselves.

verses.greek: ἕκαστος ἡμῶν τῷ πλησίον ἀρεσκέτω εἰς τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς οἰκοδομήν·
verses.literal: Each of us the neighbour should please unto the good for edification.
verses.dgt: Let each of us please the neighbor for what is good, toward building up.

verses.greek: καὶ γὰρ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐχ ἑαυτῷ ἤρεσεν· ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται· Οἱ ὀνειδισμοὶ τῶν ὀνειδιζόντων σε ἐπέπεσαν ἐπʼ ἐμέ.
verses.literal: Even for the Christ not Himself pleased but even as it has been written: The reproaches of those reproaching You fell on Me myself.
verses.dgt: For even Christ did not please himself, but just as it is written, “The insults of those insulting you fell on me.”

verses.greek: ὅσα γὰρ προεγράφη, εἰς τὴν ἡμετέραν διδασκαλίαν ἐγράφη, ἵνα διὰ τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ διὰ τῆς παρακλήσεως τῶν γραφῶν τὴν ἐλπίδα ἔχωμεν.
verses.literal: As much as for was written in the past for the our own instruction was written so that through the endurance and through the encouragement of the Scriptures the hope we may have.
verses.dgt: For whatever was written beforehand was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and through the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ τῆς παρακλήσεως δῴη ὑμῖν τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖν ἐν ἀλλήλοις κατὰ Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν,
verses.literal: The now God the of endurance and the encouragement would He give you the same to be of mind with one another according to Christ Jesus
verses.dgt: Now may the God of endurance and encouragement give you the same mind toward one another according to Christ Jesus,

verses.greek: ἵνα ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐν ἑνὶ στόματι δοξάζητε τὸν θεὸν καὶ πατέρα τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.literal: so that with one accord with one mouth you may glorify the God and Father of the Lord of us Jesus Christ.
verses.dgt: so that with one accord, with one mouth, you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.greek: Διὸ προσλαμβάνεσθε ἀλλήλους, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς προσελάβετο ὑμᾶς, εἰς δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.literal: Therefore do receive one another even as also the Christ received you to the glory the of God.
verses.dgt: Therefore receive one another, just as Christ also received you, for the glory of God.

verses.greek: λέγω γὰρ Χριστὸν διάκονον γεγενῆσθαι περιτομῆς ὑπὲρ ἀληθείας θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ βεβαιῶσαι τὰς ἐπαγγελίας τῶν πατέρων,
verses.literal: I say for Christ a servant to have become of the circumcision for the truth of God in order the to confirm the promises given to the fathers
verses.dgt: For I say that Christ became a servant of the circumcised on behalf of the truth of God, to confirm the promises to the fathers,

verses.greek: τὰ δὲ ἔθνη ὑπὲρ ἐλέους δοξάσαι τὸν θεόν· καθὼς γέγραπται· Διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν ἔθνεσι, καὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου ψαλῶ.
verses.literal: the and for the Gentiles for mercy to glorify the God even as it has been written: Because of this I will praise You among the Gentiles and to the name of You will I sing.
verses.dgt: and for the Gentiles to glorify God for mercy, just as it is written, “For this reason I will confess you among the Gentiles, and I will sing praise to your name.”

verses.greek: καὶ πάλιν λέγει· Εὐφράνθητε, ἔθνη, μετὰ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: And again it says: do rejoice you Gentiles with the people of Him.
verses.dgt: And again he says, “Rejoice, Gentiles, with his people.”

verses.greek: καὶ πάλιν· Αἰνεῖτε, πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, τὸν κύριον, καὶ ἐπαινεσάτωσαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ λαοί.
verses.literal: And again: do praise all you who are Gentiles the Lord and they should praise Him all the peoples.
verses.dgt: And again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and let all the peoples praise him.”

verses.greek: καὶ πάλιν Ἠσαΐας λέγει· Ἔσται ἡ ῥίζα τοῦ Ἰεσσαί, καὶ ὁ ἀνιστάμενος ἄρχειν ἐθνῶν· ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν.
verses.literal: And again Isaiah says: There will be the root the of Jesse and the One arising to rule over Gentiles in Him the Gentiles will hope.
verses.dgt: And again Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, and the one who rises to rule Gentiles; in him Gentiles will hope.”

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς ἐλπίδος πληρώσαι ὑμᾶς πάσης χαρᾶς καὶ εἰρήνης ἐν τῷ πιστεύειν, εἰς τὸ περισσεύειν ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἐλπίδι ἐν δυνάμει πνεύματος ἁγίου.
verses.literal: the And the God the of hope would fill you with all joy and peace in the believing for the to abound you in the hope in the power of the Spirit Holy.
verses.dgt: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that you may abound in hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

verses.greek: Πέπεισμαι δέ, ἀδελφοί μου, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐγὼ περὶ ὑμῶν, ὅτι καὶ αὐτοὶ μεστοί ἐστε ἀγαθωσύνης, πεπληρωμένοι πάσης γνώσεως, δυνάμενοι καὶ ἀλλήλους νουθετεῖν.
verses.literal: I have been persuaded now brothers of mine also myself I myself concerning you that also you yourselves full are of goodness filled with all knowledge being able also one another to admonish.
verses.dgt: And I myself am convinced concerning you, my brothers and sisters, that you yourselves also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

verses.greek: τολμηρότερον δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἀπὸ μέρους, ὡς ἐπαναμιμνῄσκων ὑμᾶς, διὰ τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ
verses.literal: More boldly however I have written to you in part as reminding you because of the grace which having been given to me by the God
verses.dgt: But I wrote to you more boldly in part, as reminding you again, because of the grace given to me by God

verses.greek: εἰς τὸ εἶναί με λειτουργὸν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ εἰς τὰ ἔθνη, ἱερουργοῦντα τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα γένηται ἡ προσφορὰ τῶν ἐθνῶν εὐπρόσδεκτος, ἡγιασμένη ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.
verses.literal: for the to be me a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles administering the sacred service of the gospel the of God so that may become the offering of the Gentiles acceptable sanctified in the Spirit Holy.
verses.dgt: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the good news of God, so that the offering of the Gentiles may become acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

verses.greek: ἔχω οὖν τὴν καύχησιν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τὰ πρὸς τὸν θεόν·
verses.literal: I have therefore the boasting in Christ Jesus the things pertaining to the God
verses.dgt: Therefore I have reason for boasting in Christ Jesus in the things relating to God.

verses.greek: οὐ γὰρ τολμήσω τι λαλεῖν ὧν οὐ κατειργάσατο Χριστὸς διʼ ἐμοῦ εἰς ὑπακοὴν ἐθνῶν, λόγῳ καὶ ἔργῳ,
verses.literal: Not for will I dare anything to speak of what except has accomplished Christ through me unto the obedience of the Gentiles by word and by deed
verses.dgt: For I will not dare to speak of anything except what Christ accomplished through me for the obedience of Gentiles, by word and deed,

verses.greek: ἐν δυνάμει σημείων καὶ τεράτων, ἐν δυνάμει πνεύματος· ὥστε με ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ κύκλῳ μέχρι τοῦ Ἰλλυρικοῦ πεπληρωκέναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.literal: in the power of signs and wonders in the power of the Spirit so as for me from Jerusalem and around unto the Illyricum to have fully proclaimed the gospel the of Christ.
verses.dgt: by the power of signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit, so that from Jerusalem and around as far as Illyricum I have fully proclaimed the good news of Christ.

verses.greek: οὕτως δὲ φιλοτιμούμενον εὐαγγελίζεσθαι οὐχ ὅπου ὠνομάσθη Χριστός, ἵνα μὴ ἐπʼ ἀλλότριον θεμέλιον οἰκοδομῶ,
verses.literal: thus now being ambitious to evangelise not where was named Christ so that not upon another’s foundation I may build
verses.dgt: And in this way I make it my ambition to announce the good news not where Christ was named, so that I might not build on another’s foundation,

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται· Οἷς οὐκ ἀνηγγέλη περὶ αὐτοῦ ὄψονται, καὶ οἳ οὐκ ἀκηκόασιν συνήσουσιν.
verses.literal: Rather even as it has been written: To whom not it was proclaimed concerning Him they will behold and those that not have heard will understand.
verses.dgt: but just as it is written, “Those to whom nothing was announced concerning him will see, and those who have not heard will understand.”

verses.greek: Διὸ καὶ ἐνεκοπτόμην τὰ πολλὰ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς·
verses.literal: Therefore also I was being hindered the many times the to come to you
verses.dgt: Therefore I also was hindered many times from coming to you.

verses.greek: νυνὶ δὲ μηκέτι τόπον ἔχων ἐν τοῖς κλίμασι τούτοις, ἐπιποθίαν δὲ ἔχων τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ ἱκανῶν ἐτῶν,
verses.literal: Now however no longer a place having in the regions these a great desire now having had the to come to you for ἱκανῶν years
verses.dgt: But now, no longer having a place in these regions, and having had a longing for many years to come to you,

verses.greek: ὡς ἂν πορεύωμαι εἰς τὴν Σπανίαν, ἐλπίζω γὰρ διαπορευόμενος θεάσασθαι ὑμᾶς καὶ ὑφʼ ὑμῶν προπεμφθῆναι ἐκεῖ ἐὰν ὑμῶν πρῶτον ἀπὸ μέρους ἐμπλησθῶ—
verses.literal: whenever maybe I shall go to the Spain I hope for going through to see you and by you to be equipped there if of you first in part I shall be filled.
verses.dgt: whenever I go to Spain—for I hope while passing through to see you and to be sent forward there by you, once I have first enjoyed your company in part—

verses.greek: νυνὶ δὲ πορεύομαι εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ διακονῶν τοῖς ἁγίοις.
verses.literal: Now however I am going to Jerusalem ministering to the saints.
verses.dgt: but now I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

verses.greek: εὐδόκησαν γὰρ Μακεδονία καὶ Ἀχαΐα κοινωνίαν τινὰ ποιήσασθαι εἰς τοὺς πτωχοὺς τῶν ἁγίων τῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
verses.literal: Were pleased for Macedonia and Achaia a contribution certain to make for the poor among the saints the in Jerusalem
verses.dgt: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.

verses.greek: εὐδόκησαν γάρ, καὶ ὀφειλέται εἰσὶν αὐτῶν· εἰ γὰρ τοῖς πνευματικοῖς αὐτῶν ἐκοινώνησαν τὰ ἔθνη, ὀφείλουσιν καὶ ἐν τοῖς σαρκικοῖς λειτουργῆσαι αὐτοῖς.
verses.literal: They were pleased for and debtors they are of them If for in the things spiritual of them shared the Gentiles they ought also in the material things to minister to them.
verses.dgt: For they were pleased, and indeed they are debtors to them. For if the Gentiles shared in their spiritual things, they also owe it to serve them in material things.

verses.greek: τοῦτο οὖν ἐπιτελέσας, καὶ σφραγισάμενος αὐτοῖς τὸν καρπὸν τοῦτον, ἀπελεύσομαι διʼ ὑμῶν εἰς Σπανίαν·
verses.literal: This therefore having finished and having sealed to them the fruit this I will set off through you into Spain.
verses.dgt: Therefore, when I have completed this and sealed this fruit to them, I will depart through you for Spain.

verses.greek: οἶδα δὲ ὅτι ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν πληρώματι εὐλογίας Χριστοῦ ἐλεύσομαι.
verses.literal: I know now that coming to you in the fullness of the blessing of Christ I will come.
verses.dgt: And I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of Christ.

verses.greek: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, διὰ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ πνεύματος συναγωνίσασθαί μοι ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ πρὸς τὸν θεόν,
verses.literal: I exhort now you brothers through the Lord of us Jesus Christ and through the love of the Spirit to strive together with me in the prayers for me to the God
verses.dgt: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, through our Lord Jesus Christ and through the love of the Spirit, to strive together with me in prayers to God on my behalf,

verses.greek: ἵνα ῥυσθῶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀπειθούντων ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ ἡ διακονία μου ἡ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ εὐπρόσδεκτος τοῖς ἁγίοις γένηται,
verses.literal: so that I may be delivered from those refusing to be persuaded in the Judea and the service of mine which is in Jerusalem acceptable to the saints may become
verses.dgt: so that I may be rescued from those who disobey in Judea and that my service for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

verses.greek: ἵνα ἐν χαρᾷ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ συναναπαύσωμαι ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: so that in joy having come to you through the will of God I may be refreshed with you.
verses.dgt: so that by the will of God I may come to you with joy and be refreshed together with you.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν· ἀμήν.
verses.literal: the And the God the of peace be with all of you Amen.
verses.dgt: Now may the God of peace be with all of you. Amen.
